name: OleoFlight
summary: OleoFlight is a flight simulator that runs right in your browser. Fly anywhere on Earth over real terrain and aerial imagery. The forests, fields and towns are built from real land-cover and OpenStreetMap data. Take to the sky in light aircraft, turboprops, airliners and helicopters, take on career jobs such as cargo runs, offshore winch rescues and firefighting, and compete in landing challenges with per-runway leaderboards. Choose the time of day and the weather, and fit your aircraft with equipment in the hangar.
